proof_method_notes.ownership_is_not_existence: Section 3 forbids proving a child fragment by the existence of its target, and MD-B01-A012 invalidated two rows for exactly that. Each owned artifact is therefore located by a distinguishing column rather than a table name — `eod_indicators` existing does not show versioned indicators, `indicator_set_version` and `formula_version` do — paired with a market-data class that produces it, and with a single application-wide assertion that nothing outside the market-data tree touches a market-data table. That last assertion is pinned to exactly three legacy Eloquent models, so a new writer elsewhere fails rather than becoming a second owner by habit.
proof_method_notes.affirmative_rules_are_not_proven_by_sile: MD-S056-R0114 states that promote owns indicators, eligibility, hash, seal, and finalize. It is proven from the real stage sequences: `promoteSingleDay` runs all five and `importSingleDay` runs `INGEST_BARS` alone under request mode `import_only`. Both halves are asserted, because the affirmative half cannot be established by the absence of the negative one.
proof_method_notes.declarative_invariants_are_two_sided: Each `X is not Y` invariant names a positive locator that must match on the surface under test and a set of downstream senses that must not. A rename emptying both searches fails on the locator instead of passing on the silence. Every forbidden pattern is also asserted to fire on the sense it forbids and to stay silent on twelve real upstream identifiers, `candidate_publication_id` among them.
proof_method_notes.conditions_of_decision_grade: MD-S056-R0004 already establishes `decision-grade` as a target property rather than an achieved claim, so conditions 1, 2, and 4 are proven by the platform expressing and enforcing each condition — an explicit `recorded_at <= knownAt` knowledge cutoff, one declared basis and factor set bound by the read product, and a freshness state that resolves to `DEVELOPMENT_NOT_OPERATIONAL` until an operational start exists — never by claiming the conditions have been met.

implementation_result.reason: Every predicate in scope was found to hold against the implementation as it stands. Section 24 of the execution contract forbids changing conforming code to manufacture implementation work, so the code changes here are confined to test tooling that was itself defective.

tooling_defects_fixed.defect: `schemaColumnMap()` matched any `->name('x')` call, so `$this->dropExisting('md_listings', [...])` registered a table name as a column of whichever table was open — and registered it from a helper whose purpose is to remove columns. `->on('eod_runs')` leaked the same way.
tooling_defects_fixed.impact: A guard asserting that a column exists could be satisfied by a namesake table or by a column a migration had just dropped. Five guards share this trait.
tooling_defects_fixed.fix: Column capture now requires a Blueprint receiver and excludes the table-naming and column-removing methods. All five consuming suites re-executed green.
tooling_defects_fixed.found_by: The A015 ownership map, whose first run reported columns present that the DDL does not contain.

tooling_defects_fixed.defect: The artifact-name guard matched bare `Candidate` against class file names.
tooling_defects_fixed.impact: A `CandidatePublicationRepository` would have been reported as a downstream artifact. `MD-S020-R0172` names this exact shape as non-conformant and `candidate_publication_id` is the boundary contract's own example.
tooling_defects_fixed.fix: `Candidate` now requires a downstream-sense compound; the other four terms stay whole-word. A two-way fixture asserts six downstream names are still caught and four legitimate upstream names are not.
tooling_defects_fixed.found_by: The new corpus-wide R0172 guard, which extracts every regex literal in the 186 market-data suites and runs it against the three overloaded bare words.

tooling_defects_fixed.defect: `ownedTerms()` was a hardcoded copy of the register naming 20 of its 33 terms.
tooling_defects_fixed.impact: Thirteen owned terms carried no redefinition guard, and the copy was a second place a term could be added — the arrangement MD-S056-R0143 exists to prevent.
tooling_defects_fixed.fix: The list is now parsed from the register table itself, with a floor assertion and a subset assertion so coverage can grow with the register but never shrink below what was already guarded. Extending to all 33 terms produced zero new findings.
tooling_defects_fixed.found_by: Deriving the R0143 proof from the register rather than from the guard.

guard_self_correction.event: The new MD-S020-R0172 guard flagged its own adequacy probe, because a literal `/candidate/i` written to prove the scan can detect a violation is itself a bare-token pattern inside the scanned corpus.
guard_self_correction.resolution: The probe is assembled at runtime instead of being written as a literal. No self-exemption was added: MD-B01-A003 records that a carve-out weakens the guard for every other file, and this is the fifth occurrence of a guard flagging the surface that is obeying the rule.
